text: 问：近日，美国一些高级官员公开表示将针对中国人工智能企业所谓“蒸馏”美前沿模型开展调查，并可能以“窃取美国知识产权”等为由制裁中国企业。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对美方将科技经贸问题政治化、工具化，以各种莫须有的理由污名化中国企业并实施制裁。美方罔顾有关中国企业人工智能模型与美前沿模型发布时间非常接近、中国部分模型能力已处于领先地位等事实，给中国企业扣上所谓依靠“蒸馏”“窃取美国知识产权”等帽子，还威胁进行打压制裁。这些做法缺乏事实依据，没有法理支撑，在实践上搞双重标准，属于典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。
text_en: Q: Recently, some senior U.S. officials publicly stated they will investigate Chinese AI companies for alleged 'distillation' of U.S. frontier models and may sanction Chinese companies under claims of 'stealing U.S. intellectual property.' What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. China consistently opposes the U.S. politicizing and weaponizing technological and economic issues, stigmatizing Chinese companies with unfounded pretexts and imposing sanctions. The U.S. ignores facts that relevant Chinese AI models were released very close in time to U.S. frontier models, and some Chinese models are already leading, instead falsely accusing Chinese companies of relying on 'distillation' and 'stealing U.S. intellectual property,' while threatening suppression and sanctions. These actions lack factual basis and legal support, apply double standards in practice, and represent typical AI hegemonism.
